summary: Zoned Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026, it and its subsidiaries entered an Amended and Restated Asset Purchase Agreement with BPB Partners, LLC, replacing the January 2026 original. The buyer acquires the company's business and substantially all assets via 100% membership interests in nine subsidiaries plus a 5% interest in ZP Ohio B, LLC. The purchase price rose to $7,800,000 from $7,000,000, reduced by buyer-assumed indebtedness elected at its sole discretion. No board recommendation, premium, or close date stated. Watch assumed-debt level and any overage payable to buyer.
